messages:
alina: Kicking off staged rollout r-2026.06.02-rc1 -> 3 waves (5% each). deploy id=20260602-rc1. Deploybot will request stop/go at each wave.
deploy-bot: Wave1 (5%) deployed to eu-west; variant=r-2026.06.02-rc1. logs: https://redwood.internal/deploy/20260602-rc1
sre-ram: Quick health: p50/p95 fine but embeddings p99 in eu-west spiked ~450ms after wave1. small bump in 502s. dash: https://dash/reports/6498765432
ben: I'm seeing increases in KV evictions and two restart events on embed-worker pods. tail: `OOMKilled` in kernel logs.
alina: Hold wave2. Deploybot hold. Can we triage without immediate rollback?
ops-bot: safety-latch applied by ben: pause_on_p99>400ms, max_wave_increment=0, notify=#eng-releases.
sre-ram: Suggest regional split: route embeddings back to previous stable (v2026-05-30) for eu-west while leaving other services on rc1. That should validate if it's embed-specific.
ben: Vote: route-split + KV purge, then re-evaluate. :thumbsup:
release-coord: Reminder: change-window closes in 18m. If we need rollback across the board after window, we'll need emergency change. Prefer regional action now.
alina: Agree. Doing route-split for embeddings -> v2026-05-30 and queue KV purge job.
deploy-bot: Executing split: embeddings->v2026-05-30 in eu-west; other routes remain on r-2026.06.02-rc1. KV purge job scheduled.
sre-ram: After split + purge: p99 dropped back to baseline and 502s reduced. good signal.
ben: Cancelling automated rollback for eu-west. `/deploy cancel 6498765432-rollback`
deploy-bot: Rollback timer canceled by human action.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-999 opened (owner: ben). Summary: memory/regression on embed pipeline after rc1; mitigation: regional embed pin, KV purge, add memory guardrails.
alina: Updating release notes: "eu-west: embeddings pinned to v2026-05-30 due to KV eviction and OOMs on r-2026.06.02-rc1; other services continue on rc1. Investigating memory regression."
sre-ram: Follow-ups: add embed-only canary stage, CI mem-regression test, and preflight KV-pressure check to rollout automation.
alina: Thanks all — keeping the stop/go open for 12h. Will file postmortem stub in #postmortems when timeline is ready.
